items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma with four assertions for a locally finite type morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces and its base change f' by g : Y' -> Y: the quasi-finite loci W and W' are open, W' is the preimage of W, and locally quasi-finite (resp. quasi-finite) morphisms are stable under base change (source lines 5323-5339). The proof replaces the two morphisms by morphisms of schemes through a double etale presentation U -> V and U' = V' x_V U -> V', uses that local quasi-finiteness is etale local on the source-and-target to translate 'quasi-finite at x' into a statement about U -> V at a chosen point u, and then invokes the scheme case for the openness of the locus, for its base change compatibility and for stability under base change, finishing the quasi-finite case with the quasi-compactness input.
